contract_constraints.description: filter must be a valid boolean expression string
contract_constraints.assertion: filter is a valid boolean expression

contract_constraints.description: id must match the collection primary key type (Int64 or VarChar)
contract_constraints.assertion: id type matches collection primary key type

contract_constraints.description: Primary key field must be specified in data for upsert
If primary key exists, entity is updated; if not, inserted. Collection must have a primary key defined
contract_constraints.assertion: upsert: update if PK exists, insert if NOT; collection has PK defined

contract_constraints.description: Primary key must match existing entity's key for updates
contract_constraints.assertion: for updates: PK value matches existing entity PK

contract_constraints.description: Delete returns 400 on invalid filter expression
Get entities returns 400 if id type mismatches collection schema

keyword_matched_segment.description: Collection must exist and be loaded; if autoID is disabled, primary key must be provided
keyword_matched_segment.assertion: collection exists AND is loaded AND (autoID OR primary key provided)
